title: Helpers on every value, pulled together
idea: TOOL, review-heavy. Pull the pattern together and preview composing (Unit 79).

exercises.prompt: The one idea of this unit:
options: Call a one-item helper inside a loop to handle every item
exercises.explanation: A helper does one item's job; the loop applies it to all.

exercises.prompt: REVIEW: total of each item's double for [3, 4]:
REVIEW (scope): each call keeps its own private notes, so repeated calls don't interfere.
exercises.explanation: Independent calls — that's why repeating a helper is safe.
12, built by hand with the helper. No sum().

exercises.prompt:
Accumulate the helper result:

total = total + ____(n)

(helper is double)
Which patterns can a helper-in-loop drive?
options: total, count, filter, or a new list
exercises.explanation: All the loop patterns: accumulate, count, filter, build.

exercises.prompt: You can now apply a tested helper to every item. Next you'll PRACTICE composing several helpers to solve bigger problems. That means...
options: breaking a problem into helpers and running/combining them
exercises.explanation: Exactly what Unit 79 practises: compose sub-plans.
